photos.desc: Reconstruction in life of Xenoposeidon, alternative version without spines. Brief advice by Rubén Molina-Pérez.
Xenoposeidon holotype BMNH R2095, left lateral view. Detail of accessory infrapostzygapophyseal lamina showing wrinkled bone texture.
Fragmentary vertebra cataloged as BMNH R96 " Chondrosteosaurus ". The internal structures are more divided than the holotype of Chondrosteosaurus , warranting it a position as Neosauropoda indet.
